pkgmetadata.longdescription: PortageHub is a graphical front end for Portage: browsing and searching packages, USE flags, keywords and masks as switches, every emerge option, previews with conflict handling, live build progress, overlays, the /etc/portage files, kernels and boot checks, cleanup and history. Privileged actions run through a small polkit-started helper that keeps an audit log and lets every configuration change be undone.
